chapters.headline: She has tried a lot of mattresses.
chapters.body: Showroom after showroom, Maya lies down, closes her eyes and tries to guess how she will feel in a year. Every bed feels fine for two minutes. None of them feel like hers.

chapters.headline: Too soft here, too firm there.
chapters.body: Her shoulders want to sink in. Her hips want to stay level. Most beds ask her to pick one and live with the other.

chapters.headline: The best suit isn't off the shelf.
chapters.body: You would never buy a suit by size alone. It gets taken in at the shoulders and let out at the waist until it fits you. Your bed can work the same way.

chapters.headline: A bed that opens up.
chapters.body: Unzip the top and look inside. TogetherBed is built from blocks that sit side by side, with nothing glued in place, so every part can be chosen for you.

chapters.headline: Shoulders, hips and legs, each tuned.
chapters.body: Each side has three zones. In every zone, a comfort block sits on a support block. Choose plush, medium or firm on top and the support you need underneath.

chapters.headline: Two people, one bed.
chapters.body: Maya sleeps on her side. Sam sleeps on his back. With TogetherBed, each side is built for the person sleeping on it, so neither of you has to meet in the middle.

chapters.headline: Swap a section, keep the bed.
chapters.body: If one zone stops feeling right, you change that block, not the whole mattress. Your bed can keep up with you over the years.

chapters.headline: Find your fit, together.
chapters.body: Sleep Fit asks a few simple questions about how you sleep, then suggests a build for each side. It takes a few minutes, and you can do it side by side.

fit.headline: Find the bed that fits you both.
fit.intro: A few questions about how you sleep, and we will suggest a build for your side. Then hand the phone to your partner for theirs.

quick.label: Quick fit
quick.blurb: Three questions, about a minute. A great place to start.

engineer.label: Fine-tune it
engineer.blurb: Go deeper with your body details and adjust each zone yourself.

skip.label: Just browse
skip.blurb: Skip the questions and look through our pre-built beds.

pose.prompt: How do you usually fall asleep?

build.prompt: How would you describe your build?

pain.prompt: Where do you tend to wake up stiff or sore?

passThePhone.headline: Now pass the phone.
passThePhone.body: Your side is ready. Hand this over so your partner can answer for their side. Their answers stay theirs, and you will see both sides together at the end.

reveal.headline: Here's your bed, side by side.
reveal.body: One bed, two builds. Each side is shaped around the person sleeping on it, zone by zone, so you can see exactly where you match and where you differ.

result.headline: Your TogetherBed, built for both of you.
result.onlineLine: Happy with one feel per side? Order the Fit line online.
result.storeLine: Want each zone tuned? Tailored and Bespoke are built with you in store.

tune.headline: Fine-tune each zone.
tune.body: We started you on the build we suggest. Change any block and watch how your alignment responds.
tune.bodyNote: This sharpens the suggestion. It stays on this device.

color.label: Your build color
color.note: Every layer of your bed has its own color. Laid together, they make this one. It is yours.

swap.headline: Change one block, not the bed.
swap.body: Every comfort and support block can be rotated, flipped or replaced on its own. When your body or your sleep changes, your bed changes with you.
steps: Lift out the block you want to change.
Drop in the new one and zip it closed.

storeHandoff.headline: Take your result to a store.
storeHandoff.body: Pick a store near you and email them your Sleep Fit result. It includes both sides, zone by zone, so the team can see exactly what to build.

callAhead.headline: Give them a call first.
callAhead.body: A quick call ahead lets the store build your bed before you arrive, so you can lie down on your own setup when you walk in.
